Name: Tenkai Family Life
Author: TENKAITENSHI
Description:
Make family life a bigger part of your farm.
Tenkai Family Life gives your walking children individual personalities and everyday interactions, then brings your household together for animated dinners, forest picnics, and interactive dice nights.
Whether your household includes one spouse or a larger family supported by compatible mods, there is room for everyone.
[b]Get to know each child[/b]
Every child develops persistent interests and food preferences. One might love nature and exploring, while another enjoys stories, music, art, or cooking. Children also have a favorite cooked meal, a favorite fruit, and a disliked food.
Siblings can have different personalities even when they share the same appearance. Conversations reflect their interests, affection, the weather, and the time of day. Keep talking to discover what makes each child unique.
[b]Natural everyday interactions[/b]
Interact directly with your children using right-click:
[list]
[*]With empty hands, talk to them and earn daily affection.[/*]
[*]After finishing their dialogue, interact again to show affection.[/*]
[*]Hold suitable food to offer it directly and receive a reaction based on their tastes.[/*]
[/list]Daily limits prevent repeated interactions from granting unlimited affection. You can still enjoy additional conversations after receiving the daily reward.
Speaking interactions and family activities are intended for walking children. Babies and crawling children do not participate in the cinematic scenes.
[b]Share a family dinner[/b]
Gather around one table for an evening together, with arrivals, serving food, a toast, eating animations, laughter, and conversation.
Dinner is available at home from [b]6:00 PM to 8:50 PM[/b]. Hold a cooked dish when starting it. One shared portion is consumed when the activity finishes successfully.
Children can remember the completed dinner in their conversations the following day.
[b]Enjoy a forest picnic[/b]
Visit the central island in Cindersap Forest, near Leah’s cottage, for a peaceful family outing.
Watch your family arrive across the bridge and gather around a picnic blanket, surrounded by seasonal scenery, moving water, and drifting leaves.
Picnics are available from [b]9:00 AM to 5:50 PM[/b] on days without rain. No inventory items are required.
[b]Play an interactive dice night[/b]
Bring everyone together for a friendly game of chance.
Roll your die, then watch each participating relative take a turn. The highest result wins, and tied players share the victory. Conversations change depending on the winner and the family members involved.
Dice night is available from [b]6:00 PM to 11:50 PM[/b], with no inventory items required.
Completed picnics and dice nights grant affection. Each activity has its own daily limit, and cancelling an activity grants no reward.
[b]Controls[/b]
Press [b]F6 at home[/b], or interact with a table, to open the family activity menu. The shortcut is configurable.
During scenes:
[list]
[*][b]Enter / Controller A:[/b] advance or roll when prompted.[/*]
[*][b]P / Space / Controller X:[/b] pause or resume.[/*]
[*][b]Escape / Controller B:[/b] cancel.[/*]
[/list]On-screen buttons are also available.
[b]Requirements and compatibility[/b]
Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4.0 or later[/b].
Designed for [b]single-player[/b]. Optional integrations support [b]Tenkai Hereditary Children[/b] and [b]Tenkai Harem Love[/b].
This mod does not add marriages, increase the child limit, or include replacement character artwork. Overhauls that replace children with a different NPC type are unsupported. The picnic scene assumes the standard Forest layout.
Family activities use full-screen cinematic scenes while preserving the characters’ actual locations and routines.
[b]Installation[/b]
Extract the ZIP and place the [b]TenkaiFamilyLife[/b] folder inside your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder. Launch the game through SMAPI. When updating, preserve your existing
[code]config.json[/code].
[b]Languages and credits[/b]
Includes [b]English and Spanish[/b], selected automatically from your game language. Other languages fall back to English.
Created by [b]Tenkai Tenshi[/b]. Ambient chuckle by [b]amoyssiadis[/b], used under CC0 1.0; attribution is included in the package.
Screenshots show a staged demonstration family. Optional character appearance mods shown in the images are separate downloads and are not included.
